_comment: The ROS 2 distributions this workstation supports, and the default.
Each is pinned to the digest of docker.io/library/ros:<distro>-ros-base,
the multi-architecture index its image builds FROM. ROS_DISTRO=<name>
chooses one; make and ros2.ps1 pass the matching digest to the build.
`make digest` fetches every current digest and rewrites this file;
`make distros` lists them. The default's ARG and compose defaults in
Dockerfile and compose.yaml must match its entry here. Each has its own
noVNC host port, so several desktops can run at once; 6081 is left to
